title: Nibbles - Service health
description: Requests, errors and latency; accounts; Gemini and email; grocery runs and their Temporal worker; the database; and the .NET runtime, for every instance of the app.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: The app's own health checks, every 30 seconds: the database and, with grocery runs, the Temporal worker (Degraded while it can't reach Temporal Cloud). No data means the app isn't sending metrics.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with 5xx.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of request duration (the realtime hub's WebSockets aren't counted).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU the app's process uses, in cores (each instance has 0.5).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of the app's process (each instance has 1 GiB).

panels.title: Rate limits
panels.description: Requests under each rate limit: acquired went through; endpoint_limiter and global_limiter were refused with 429.

panels.title: Exceptions
panels.description: Unhandled exceptions (turned into 500s by the exception handler), and every exception thrown, handled or not.

panels.title: Sign-in attempts
panels.description: Password checks at sign-in, by result (failure, locked_out, success).

panels.title: Registrations
panels.description: Accounts created; failure is a refused registration (duplicate email, weak password).

panels.title: Registration emails
panels.description: Emails to the site owner about new registrations, by outcome.

panels.title: Pictures drawn (24 h)
panels.description: Pictures Gemini drew (and charged for) in the last 24 hours, per site. The app stops at ImageGeneration:MaxImagesPerDay (100).

panels.title: Cost estimates (24 h)
panels.description: Estimates that reached Gemini in the last 24 hours, per site. The app stops at CostEstimates:MaxEstimatesPerDay (500).

panels.title: Gemini response time (p95)
panels.description: Over the last 30 minutes of requests.

panels.title: Pictures by outcome
panels.description: drawn: a new picture; reused: the picture of an item with the same name; failed: Gemini refused or failed; daily_limit: none asked for.

panels.title: Cost estimates by outcome
panels.description: Presses of Estimate Cost: succeeded, model_busy (try again soon), model_failed, daily_limit_reached, empty_list, not_available.

panels.title: Calls to Gemini and Cloudflare
panels.description: Outgoing HTTP: generativelanguage.googleapis.com (pictures, estimates) and api.cloudflare.com (emails). Retries included.

panels.title: Runs started (7 d)
panels.description: Grocery runs that opened last call in the last 7 days, per site.

panels.title: Temporal worker
panels.description: The app's Temporal worker, per site: Healthy while it polls its task queue, Degraded while it can't reach Temporal Cloud (it keeps retrying; the list itself is unaffected). No data: Temporal isn't configured.

panels.title: Grocery runs
panels.description: Runs started, and how they ended: finished (the shopper said so), expired (the shopping time limit passed) or cancelled.

panels.title: Temporal failures (24 h)
panels.description: Calls to Temporal Cloud that failed, and activities that failed and were retried, in the last 24 hours. A few are normal (deployments); a steady stream means trouble.

panels.title: Workflow tasks waiting (p95)
panels.description: How long workflow tasks waited for the worker over the last 30 minutes. High means the worker is busy or not polling.

panels.title: How last call ended
panels.description: everyone_ready: everyone asked said "I'm good" in time; time_up: the timer decided; shopper_went_early: the shopper didn't wait.

panels.title: Workflow and activity latency (p95)
panels.description: Over the last 30 minutes: how long the worker took per workflow task and per activity (saving a run and pushing it to phones), and how long activities waited for it.

panels.title: Calls to Temporal Cloud
panels.description: Calls the app makes to Temporal Cloud, by operation (starting and signalling workflows, completing tasks), and the ones that failed. Long polls are counted separately.

panels.title: Worker slots and pollers
panels.description: Task slots in use by the worker, and its open long polls to Temporal Cloud. Pollers at 0 mean the worker is not taking work.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: Npgsql's connections to PostgreSQL, idle and in use, against the pool's maximum.

panels.title: Queries, saves and conflicts
panels.description: Edit conflicts are two people changing the same item at once (the second gets 409).

panels.title: Thread pool
panels.description: A growing queue means the app can't keep up (blocked threads or too little CPU).
